excerpt:
Shall Bartholomew Consolidated School Corporation continue to increase
property taxes paid to the school corporation for no more than eight (8) years for
the purpose of funding and maintaining competitive compensation for teachers
and staff and maintaining student safety by imposing a property tax rate that does
not exceed $0.156 and results in a maximum annual amount that does not exceed
$10,100,000. If this operating referendum public question is NOT approved by
the voters, for a median residence of $250,000, the property’s annual tax bill
would decrease by $190 per year. If this operating referendum public question is
approved by the voters, it would be a renewal of the most recent operating
referendum public question passed in 2020 with a property tax rate of $0.156.
